title: Sage weather_pattern record
description: A weather_pattern record (WeatherPatternRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another weather_pattern record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

slotHours.description: How long a draw lasts, in game hours: the weather can change this often. Unit: h. At least 0.10000000149011612. (float, default 3)

transition.description: How long the weather takes to change to what was drawn. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 30)

seed.description: Mixed into every draw: two patterns with different seeds do not share a sequence of weather. (int, default 0)

picks.description: What the weather can be; one is drawn by weight from those that apply to the hour and the region. (List<WeatherPick>)

from.description: The hour of the day this can begin at (inclusive); with To, wraps past midnight. Unit: h. Range: 0 to 24. (float)

to.description: The hour it stops being possible (exclusive); From 0 and To 24 is all day. Unit: h. Range: 0 to 24. (float)

region.description: Only in this region (the world's Weather.Region); empty is everywhere. (string)

weight.description: How likely, against the other picks that apply. At least 0. (float)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.

picks+.description: Adds to "picks": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.
